title: Factor Plane — Spec + Compute + Audit
description: Implement factor definition, computation, and audit. Factor spec as YAML, compute factor values from data, audit with IC/RankIC/coverage/leakage risk.
action: Create synapse/factor/ module: (1) FactorSpec dataclass with fields: factor_id, name, description, domain, inputs, formula, frequency, direction, universe, created_by, version; (2) compute_factor(spec, data) that executes formula against DataFrame; (3) audit_factor(factor_values, returns) that computes coverage, missing_rate, IC, RankIC, leakage_risk; (4) Sample factor: factors/sample_momentum.yaml defining a simple 20-day momentum factor.
implementation: Create synapse/factor/spec.py: @dataclass FactorSpec with all contract fields, from_yaml(path), to_yaml(path), compute_next_version(spec) that increments version
Create synapse/factor/compute.py: compute_factor(spec: FactorSpec, data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series that evaluates spec.formula against data, handles missing values

Create synapse/factor/audit.py: audit_factor(factor_values: pd.Series, forward_returns: pd.Series) -> FactorAuditResult dataclass with: coverage, missing_rate, ic, rank_ic, leakage_risk, distribution_summary; use scipy.stats.spearmanr for RankIC, numpy corrcoef for IC
Create factors/sample_momentum.yaml: factor_id='momentum-20d', name='20-Day Momentum', formula='close / close.shift(20) - 1', frequency='daily', direction='positive'
Write tests: test_factor_spec.py (YAML roundtrip, version increment), test_factor_compute.py (compute against sample data), test_factor_audit.py (audit returns valid metrics)

criteria: synapse/factor/audit.py imports 'from scipy.stats import spearmanr' or uses equivalent rank correlation
pytest tests/unit/test_factor_spec.py tests/unit/test_factor_compute.py tests/unit/test_factor_audit.py all pass
